scope: Native static/discrete live-event validation, due application, acknowledgement and failure rollback
Accepted continuous observation-grid stop with no subsequent transition
Standalone TypeScript charging, child capability manifests, owned-source extraction and full-result parity
Worker replay-model construction and actual generated replay execution

issues.finding: An unconditional live-event hook made native execution reject every static or continuous Worker run.
issues.resolution: Only discrete execution receives takeDashboardEvents; existing pause/resume hooks remain available in all modes.
issues.verification: Read the corrected conditional spread. Actual browser regressions remain part of the coordinator's final UI gate.

issues.finding: Generated charging checked the operation cap only every64 work units, unlike native's immediate pre-charge check. Dynamic child work could cross the cap before a stop or sample was published.
issues.resolution: Compute nextOperations and reject every charge above50000000 before assigning it, with the same owning-node diagnostic as native execution.
issues.verification: Read the immediate guard and executed the129-test actual standalone codegen suite.

issues.finding: A real nested M13 string child executed correctly but was marked typescript-m11-v1; nested table data references were not discovered.
issues.resolution: Bounded traversal of compiler-owned executable scope/analysis/algebraic program nodes selects capabilities and data references. Root public-node metadata remains separate.
issues.verification: Actual nested string and nested table models now report typescript-m13-v1; the table includes its data reference. Both actual standalone cases passed in codegen tests.

issues.finding: Live control minus zero produced the typed string '-0', while JSON receipt replay produced '0'. Initial or scheduled minus zero had the same serialization boundary.
issues.resolution: Only M13 JSON-number control values canonicalize zero before publication and acknowledgement, including held initial publication before an offset tick. Computed arithmetic minus zero and earlier typed IEEE contracts remain intact.
issues.verification: Focused real compiled live/scheduled/initial/offset publication and replay test passed. No source-proof fixture count changed.

issues.finding: Five source approvals restricted to ASCII were initially attached to Unicode-extension models.
issues.resolution: Source rows18-005/007/009/010/015 now have explicit ASCII profiles. Their Unicode models remain independently tested without native-source approval tags.
issues.verification: All374 tests passed after the profile addition; the source-identity audit confirms only ASCII profiles carry those five IDs.

issues.finding: The approved default1Hz waveform was sampled only at zeros, allowing a zero-output substitute to pass that configured oracle.
issues.resolution: Keep source parameters unchanged and observe t=0,0.25,0.5 with independent expected values0,1,0.
issues.verification: Both discrete and continuous focused models passed.

actualChecks.name: authoritative-template-extraction-equality
actualChecks.method: Read-only buildFixedTemplates compared to the four committed trusted template constants after the final control-zero fix.

reviewedGateProperties: The M13 verifier executes every declared legal mode through actual emitted TypeScript, checks complete output-ID sets and full native/generated contracts, and strictly type-checks all three templates.
Source models remain immutable; model JSON roundtrip and reversed insertion-order execution are checked.
IEEE tagged values and integer/string outputs use exact comparison where the verifier declares it.
Catalog metadata is explicitly distinguished from independent numerical literals.
After source approvals exist, future verification writes a separate regression report rather than replacing frozen release evidence.
Live hooks are discrete-only; control queues, drain batches, per-node event logs and record capacity are bounded. Only approved receipts enter the replay model.
Continuous stop observes the declared output grid; instant zero-crossing stop equivalence is not claimed.
excludedClaims: No MathWorks execution or full R2024b option equivalence was tested or claimed.
Browser UI final gates and the coordinator's final complete M13 verifier are not replaced by this independent review.
External rejected live events are not serialized as successful replay input.
